title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Schedule of Cancellation Refund Terms
content:
Cancellation terms of the Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract, by plan: the free-look period during which cancellation brings a full refund, the fee deducted from a refund after that period, how the refund is computed after the free-look period, whether claims paid come off the refund, and whether a refund on a financed plan goes first to the Kestrel account that financed it.

| Plan | Free-look period (calendar days after purchase) | Cancellation fee after the free-look period (USD) | Refund method after the free-look period | Claims paid deducted from the refund | Refund on a financed plan paid to the financing Kestrel account |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 60 | 50.00 | Pro rata on the greater of time used or mileage used | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 60 | 50.00 | Pro rata on the greater of time used or mileage used | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 60 | 50.00 | Pro rata on the greater of time used or mileage used | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 60 | 50.00 | Pro rata on the greater of time used or mileage used | No | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 60 | 50.00 | Pro rata on the greater of time used or mileage used | No | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 60 | 50.00 | Pro rata on the greater of time used or mileage used | No | Yes |

### Distinguishing the plans

The plans differ in this schedule on one column only: claims paid are deducted from a cancellation refund on Kestrel Care Powertrain, Kestrel Care Gold and Kestrel Care Gold Plus, and are not deducted on Kestrel Care Platinum, Kestrel Care Platinum Plus and Kestrel Care Platinum Elite. The free-look period, the cancellation fee, the refund method and the payment of a financed plan's refund to the financing Kestrel account are the same on every plan.
